citations.quote: Phase one, recovery. From late twenty eleven, the confidence crept back. Prices ticked up.
Phase two, expansion. Dubai won Expo in November twenty thirteen, and the market cut fire, sixty one percent growth under two years.

observation.text: The explanation of market phases is structured into distinct stages: recovery, expansion, and hyper supply.

citations.quote: Supply always arrives late to the party.

observation.text: Uses the metaphor 'supply always arrives late to the party' to describe the timing of market supply relative to demand.

citations.quote: Developers launch when the prices are booming, but the tower takes three or four years. So everything launched in A4 year of 2013 delivered in a cool down market of two thousand sixteen, seventeen, eighteen.

summary.text: Developers launch projects when prices are booming, resulting in a late supply that arrives during market cool down phases.
